turns.text: Hey Jolene, had a tough week. Storm forced us to cancel our yoga getaway.
Sorry to hear about it. How are you feeling now?

I was bummed about it, but I'm doing better now. It was just a setback, but I found comfort in my work and spending time at home. Reminds me to be grateful for the little things. And you? How's it going?
My partner and I plan a camping trip to connect with nature and practice yoga.
It can be both good and tough to plan activities with a busy schedule - what strategies do you use?

Having a routine helps me stay on top of everything I need to do. I have a schedule for classes, studying, and personal time. Self-care activities like yoga and meditation help me stay balanced and relax.
I'd love to learn more about how you do it.
I can tell you about it if you're interested. It took a bit of experimenting, but it's really helped me.
Sounds great! Let's set up a coffee date and talk about it!
Wanna meet up at that cafe next Monday? Let's try fresh pastries.
Sounds good, Jolene! When did you have in mind? That cafe rocks.
How about Wednesday at 4? Can't wait to catch up over coffee!
That pic looks so peaceful. Reminded me of a cool hidden coffee shop near me. Rate it!
Tell me more about it when we meet, maybe next time we’ll be there.
Sorry, I remembered that I already have plans for this day.
Now I'll see when it's more convenient for me.
Thank you for your understanding, I'm waiting.
How about Friday at 5? I will need to sort out the books from this bookcase and I will be free.
Absolutely, let's do that! Can't wait for our coffee date next week. See you then. Stay safe!
See ya soon, Deb! Be safe and I'm excited for our coffee date!
Maybe just grab me some interesting books!
